candidates.statement: Reconcile metered usage against the billing pipeline and record the difference, including non-zero results.
candidates.rationale: A non-zero financial difference is a Batch 45 zero-tolerance item, so this gates final certification.

candidates.statement: Replace the zero artifactDigest and environmentDigest in pack.json with digests of the actual built artifact and pinned environment.
candidates.rationale: Purely mechanical once a reproducible build exists; unblocks every downstream evidence check.

candidates.statement: Write the evidence.json claim set so every support-matrix capability resolves to a named claim.
candidates.rationale: Prerequisite for the evidence manifest; the claim list is derivable from the support matrix.

candidates.statement: Emit the batch metric set from real runs instead of leaving them unmeasured.
candidates.rationale: Each metric maps to an existing subsystem; work is bounded but touches many services.

candidates.statement: Name accountable approvers on the certification and an independent verifier distinct from the executor.
candidates.rationale: No engineering effort, but it is an organisational decision that nobody has made yet.

candidates.statement: Evaluate every zero-tolerance flag for this batch and record the observed count, including non-zero results.
candidates.rationale: Cheap to wire, and an unevaluated flag is indistinguishable from a violated one at the gate.

candidates.statement: Author a holdout corpus and a representative production-shaped workload, held by someone outside the implementing team.
candidates.rationale: Highest single unblocker: no metric can be trusted without it, but it needs an owner outside the implementers.

candidates.statement: Provision the offline certification key, publish the trust store and sign the certification request.
candidates.rationale: One-time setup shared by all eight batches; currently the hard blocker on any CERTIFIED status.
